original.title: NASA Astronauts to Answer Questions from Florida Students
original.summary: Students in Florida will hear from NASA astronauts Jessica Watkins and Luke Delaney as they answer prerecorded STEM questions while aboard the International Space Station. The Earth-to-space call will begin at 12 p.m. EDT Friday, Oct. 16, and will stream live on the agency’s Learn With NASA YouTube channel. This event is hosted by Sally Ride Elementary School […]
original.podcastScript:
Hello, this is Earth Signal.

Today's story comes from NASA News: NASA Astronauts to Answer Questions from Florida Students.

The report says: Students in Florida will hear from NASA astronauts Jessica Watkins and Luke Delaney as they answer prerecorded STEM questions while aboard the International Space Station. The Earth-to-space call will begin at 12 p.m. EDT Friday, Oct. 16, and will stream live on the agency’s Learn With NASA YouTube channel. This event is hosted by Sally Ride Elementary School […]

The signal is the longer trend behind the headline: how technology keeps moving into public life, infrastructure, science and everyday decisions.
original.aiInsight: The important signal is not just the event, but the system it points to: technology is becoming part of how societies manage risk, opportunity and trust.

zh.title: 太空与卫星技术释放新的地球观测信号
zh.summary: 这条新闻关注太空与卫星技术的新进展，它可能帮助人类更好理解地球、气候、灾害或未来探索。
zh.podcastScript:
今天的 Earth Signal 来自全球科技新闻现场。

我们关注的是：太空与卫星技术释放新的地球观测信号。这条新闻关注太空与卫星技术的新进展，它可能帮助人类更好理解地球、气候、灾害或未来探索。

如果把它放在更长的时间线上看，这不只是一次技术更新。它说明科技正在更深地进入城市、公共服务、环境风险和普通人的日常选择。

值得听的地方在于：真正改变生活的，往往不是某个单点发明，而是它和社会系统连接起来之后，开始重新分配效率、风险和机会。

今天的信号是：技术越靠近地球，越需要被听见的不只是速度，还有它会把我们带向怎样的生活。
zh.aiInsight: 这条新闻真正指向的，是人类正在用更高维度的技术重新理解地球。当太空、气候和城市治理连在一起，科技就不只是远方的探索，也会变成每个人生活里的安全感。
